review.tagline: Multi-agent social simulation engine that predicts outcomes from seed documents
review.summary: MiroFish builds a GraphRAG knowledge graph from uploaded seed material such as news, policy drafts or novels, then generates agent personas and runs a parallel social simulation on the OASIS engine. A ReportAgent writes a prediction report, and you can chat with individual simulated agents afterward. It uses any OpenAI-format LLM API plus Zep Cloud for memory.
review.audience: Analysts testing scenarios or policy reactions with LLM agent simulations
strengths: End-to-end pipeline: graph building, persona generation, simulation, report, and agent chat
Works with any OpenAI-SDK-compatible LLM endpoint via LLM_BASE_URL
Public live demo available without installing anything
Docker Compose and source install both documented, ports 3000 and 5001
weaknesses: Requires Zep Cloud API key, so memory is not fully self-hosted
README warns of high LLM token consumption; suggests under 40 rounds first
AGPL-3.0 license restricts closed-source network use
README gives no evidence of prediction accuracy or benchmarks
needs: Needs Zep Cloud, OpenAI-compatible LLM API, Node.js 18+, Python 3.11-3.12, uv
